I'd just taken a swig of a heat-resistance beverage.|Note on the Table|TotK}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Drinking Chilly Elixirs will grant [[Link]] one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. They do this by providing a cooling effect, making them important for travelling through the [[Gerudo Desert]]. When spoken to, [[Guy]] the [[Rito]] will complain about the heat at [[Kara Kara Bazaar]].{{Cite|But it's so incredibly hot here during the day. It's been tough to work up the will to go any farther.|Guy|BotW}} He explains that he's heard of an [[Elixir]] that can help with the heat, but it isn't sold at the Bazaar.{{Cite|I hear there's an {{Color BotW|Red|elixir that can help beat the heat}}. It's made from {{Color BotW|Blue|insects with cooling effects}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|monster parts}}. But they don't seem to be selling the elixir anywhere...|Guy|BotW}} However, despite knowing that he can find the insects needed in the [[Gerudo Highlands]], Guy isn't motivated due to the monsters up there.{{Cite|I've heard {{Color BotW|Blue|insects with these cooling effects}} live in {{Color BotW|Blue|the cold parts of the Gerudo Highlands}}, but... Well, the monsters there are rough, to say the least, so I'm not having a lot of success getting myself motivated...|Guy|BotW}} This initiates the [[Side Quest]] "[[An Ice Guy]]". Link can make a Chilly Elixir for Guy, who will be happy he can cross the [[Gerudo Desert]] during the day.{{Cite|[Here's an elixir.] Thank you! Now I can get across the desert while it's still light out!|Guy|BotW}} He'll give Link 50 [[Rupee]]s as a reward.{{Cite|Here, let me give you something in return.|Guy|BotW}} Chilly Elixirs can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]: * [[Cold Darner]] * [[Winterwing Butterfly]] By adding any of these chilly ingredients, Link can make a Chilly Elixir that will also heal him: * [[Hydromelon]] * [[Chillshroom]] * [[Cool Safflina]] * [[Chillfin Trout]] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
